summary.en: Iranian-backed Houthi forces have launched attacks on Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Aden, while Iran has stepped up targeting of U.S. personnel, threatening Gulf oil facilities, AI sites and undersea cables. Iran warned it will not allow U.S. warships near its waters as U.S. and Israeli planners consider renewed strikes after the U.S. midterm elections. Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov visited Tehran and publicly backed Iran, hinting at possible Russian involvement. Saudi Arabia is expanding a missile plant that may produce more powerful missiles. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
